outcome.answer: For identifiers that adapt to changing user behavior during training, DACT is the closest match: it detects item-level collaborative drift, then reassigns codes with a relaxed-to-strict strategy that limits unnecessary changes to existing identifiers [5]. If you want to refresh IDs from recent interaction logs while keeping the retriever compatible, another option aligns refreshed IDs to the existing vocabulary and supports warm-start fine-tuning [2].
